_note: Invented tracker tickets for testing only. See README.md in this folder.

tickets.description: Umbrella epic for letting customers manage their own subscription.
We should let the user leverage a self-serve flow to pause whenever. Should also work for cancelled plans so they can pause those too, for as many cycles as they want.

Match the new confirmation layout.
[image: pause-confirmation-mock.png]
[panel: note] Keep the existing copy for the resume date; legal has signed off on it. [/panel]
The screen shows the resume date and the next charge date.
Customers can pause a plan themselves, resume it early from the account page, and get an email reminder a few days before a pause ends. Each of these is its own screen and its own flow.

tickets.summary: Add a pause button to the account page
tickets.description: A customer can pause an active plan from the account page. Done when the button pauses the plan, shows the resume date, and is hidden for cancelled plans.
A customer can resume a paused plan before the pause ends. Done when the next charge date is recomputed and shown.

tickets.summary: Email a reminder before a pause ends
tickets.description: Send the customer an email a few days before a paused plan resumes. Done when the email sends once per pause and links back to the account page.

tickets.summary: Show order history on the account page
tickets.description: A customer sees their recent orders on the account page. Done when the last ten orders are listed with dates and totals.

tickets.summary: Let a customer change their pause length
tickets.description: A customer can shorten or extend an existing pause within the allowed limit. Done when the new resume date is saved and shown.

tickets.summary: Show a banner while a plan is paused
tickets.description: Show a banner on the account page while a plan is paused, with the resume date. Done when the banner appears only for paused plans.

tickets.summary: Export a customer's order history to a file
tickets.description: Support can export a customer's order history as a file. Done when the file downloads with one row per order.

tickets.summary: Add a self-serve data export request
tickets.description: A customer can request an export of their own data from the account page. Done when the request is queued and the customer sees a confirmation.

tickets.summary: Email the export file when it is ready
tickets.description: Email the customer a secure link when their export file is ready. Done when the link expires after a day.

tickets.summary: Stand up the secure file store
tickets.description: Provide the secure store that export files are written to. Owned by the platform team.
